package.description: Local-first 多设备 AI 项目工作台：统一管理项目、worktree、终端、文件、Git、Mobile Workbench 与自动化交付。

en-US.description: A local-first multi-device project workbench for AI coding workflows, bringing projects, worktrees, terminals, files, Git, Mobile Workbench, and automated delivery into one visible flow.
en-US.longDescription: cc-partner is a local-first, multi-device project workbench. It does not write code for models; instead it puts projects, worktrees, terminals, files, Git, browser previews, and automation tasks on local and LAN-remote devices into one visible flow, so you always know what an agent is doing, where it is stuck, and how it will deliver. Project → Worktree → Window → Pane boundaries keep terminals and branch state clear, the Workbench continuously shows terminals, sessions, and blockers, and Mobile Workbench lets you view and take over the same project from your phone. The Orchestrator keeps validation evidence and closes the delivery loop from fixing and reviewing to committing, pushing, and merging.

zh-CN.description: Local-first 多设备 AI 项目工作台：统一管理项目、worktree、终端、文件、Git、Mobile Workbench 与自动化交付。
zh-CN.longDescription: cc-partner 是一款 local-first 多设备项目工作台。它不替模型写代码，而是把本机与局域网远端的项目、worktree、终端、文件、Git、浏览器预览和自动化任务放进同一条可见流程：Agent 在推进，你随时知道它做到哪、卡在哪、接下来怎么交付。它通过 Project → Worktree → Window → Pane 建立清晰边界，在 Workbench 中持续展示终端、会话与阻塞，并可通过 Mobile Workbench 在手机上查看和接手同一项目；Orchestrator 保存验证证据，串起修复、复核、commit、push 与 merge 的交付闭环。
zh-CN.name: cc-partner
